mechanism_criteria.development_policy: Retrospective revision after inspection of existing predictions. Not preregistered. Applies to this case only; the main201 ledger is not overwritten.

atom_policy.Nu: One of the three nonprotonated, nonbridging oxygens on AMP phosphate.
atom_policy.LG: The oxygen bridging ATP beta and gamma phosphorus atoms.
atom_policy.Mg_beta_donor: One of the two nonbridging oxygens on the same ATP beta phosphate.
atom_policy.Mg_gamma_donor: One of the three nonbridging oxygens on the same ATP gamma phosphate.
atom_policy.joint_rule: Distance and angle must pass for the same AMP oxygen and the same Pgamma/LG pair. Both metal donors must belong to that same ATP and coordinate the same declared Mg.
atom_policy.too_short_policy: Any AMP terminal oxygen closer to Pgamma than the reaction-distance lower bound fails the reactant compression guard. For each ATP Mg donor group, its shortest Mg-O distance must satisfy both bounds; a different oxygen cannot hide an excessively short contact.
atom_policy.equivalence: Localized P=O versus P-O(-) drawing does not freeze phosphate oxygen identity for the declared unprotonated input. No alternative substrate copy or arbitrary nearest oxygen is permitted.

reaction_distance_A.upper_basis: 8RJ6 chain A ATP altloc A with AMP has O1P-PG = 3.582868 A. A 4.0 A ceiling retains this observed ground-state arrangement with approximately 0.42 A operational allowance; it is not an experimental confidence interval.
reaction_distance_A.lower_basis: 2.5 A is an author-defined compression guard for an intact reactant-preorganization task, not a measured lower quantile. It excludes unusually compressed or bond-like approach geometries from this task without claiming they are necessarily chemically impossible.

attack_angle_deg.basis: 8RJ6 chain A O1P-PG-O3B = 166.957218 degrees, consistent with the paper's 167 degrees. The 150-degree floor allows up to 30 degrees from collinearity. Supplementary Table S3 reports RS MD mean angle 153.0 +/- 7.1 degrees: legitimate dynamics can cross this boundary. This is a screen for the declared preorganized geometry, not a universal activity threshold or a test of all physically possible bound states.

Mg_beta_distance_A.basis: 8RJ6 Mg-O1B is approximately 2.022 A. Same-species AP5-1ZIO Mg-O2B is approximately 2.222 A. 1.8-2.6 A is a deliberately broad author-defined direct-contact compatibility window, not a full coordination-geometry certificate.

Mg_gamma_distance_A.basis: 8RJ6 Mg-O2G is approximately 1.903 A. Same-species AP5-1ZIO Mg-O2G is approximately 2.176 A. The same 1.8-2.6 A operational window is applied to both ATP donor groups.

aggregation.sample_task_pass: One complete legal tuple simultaneously satisfies all four numeric conditions.
aggregation.sample_joint_pass: sample_task_pass AND the separately recorded basic structural checks pass.
aggregation.Top1: The original model-native confidence rank, not a geometry-selected sample.
aggregation.Best5: At least one entire sample passes; never combine conditions across samples.
aggregation.missing_required_atom: Record missing component/atom or mapping failure explicitly; never impute a zero distance or a success.

not_required_for_task_pass: Direct Mg-AMP coordination: retained as a measured diagram-versus-reference discrepancy.
Four coordinating waters: absent in the prediction input; no complete octahedral-shell verdict.
Full Zn site restoration: separate structural-metal task.
All catalytic-residue contacts, catalytic rates, reaction barriers or transition-state stabilization.
A ligand RMSD to AP5: AP5 is not separate ATP plus AMP.
reference_limits: 8RJ6 is the E. coli homolog, not the same species as 1ZIO.
Use only chain A ATP altloc A (occupancy 0.62), AMP and compatible blank-altloc Mg. Do not combine the alternate ADP state or chain B.
Crystal coordinates support heavy-atom geometry but do not certify the protonation of the benchmark input.
The 2005 MD used a different enzyme and ligand protonation setup and a modeled hydrated Mg site. Its Mg topology is supporting evidence, not a source of numerical pass/fail quantiles.

Nam 2024 Supplementary Table S3 uses ATP protonated at O1G in RS simulations; its reported mean distance 3.43 +/- 0.06 A and mean angle 153.0 +/- 7.1 degrees are contextual, not distributions fitted to this fully deprotonated input.
The M-CSA diagram shows a different Mg-AMP contact. The metal criterion is literature-curated, not literal compliance with every diagram line.
The project Mg-O distribution was preselected and pooled across chemical contexts; it supports distance scale, not a universal coordination cutoff.

MCSA0290_STEP1.supports: Reacting atoms and in-line phosphoryl transfer; original metal diagram discrepancy preserved.

NAM2024_8RJ6_A.citation: Nam K et al. Magnesium induced structural reorganization in the active site of adenylate kinase. Science Advances 10, eado5504 (2024).
NAM2024_8RJ6_A.locator: Figures 1D and 2A; Supplementary Tables S2 and S3; chain A ATP altloc A
NAM2024_8RJ6_A.supports: Reactant-state reaction axis and beta/gamma Mg donor topology.

KRISHNAMURTHY2005.citation: Krishnamurthy H et al. Associative mechanism for phosphoryl transfer: A molecular dynamics simulation of Escherichia coli adenylate kinase complexed with its substrates. Proteins 58, 88-100 (2005).
KRISHNAMURTHY2005.locator: Starting Structure; Force Field; Figure 6; Catalytic Mechanism
KRISHNAMURTHY2005.supports: Supporting beta/gamma Mg coordination and distinction between modeled reactant and shorter transition-state/bond geometries, not the proposed cutoff numbers.

BERRY1998_1ZIO.citation: Berry MB, Phillips GN Jr. Crystal structures of Bacillus stearothermophilus adenylate kinase with bound Ap5A, Mg2+ Ap5A, and Mn2+ Ap5A reveal an intermediate lid position and six coordinate octahedral geometry for bound Mg2+ and Mn2+. Proteins 32, 276-288 (1998).
BERRY1998_1ZIO.supports: Same-species AP5 analog Mg coordination distances and structural Zn role; not a native ATP-plus-AMP distance standard.

PROJECT_MG_O_REFERENCE.supports: Existing 317 selected Mg-O contacts from 48 M-CSA/PDB pairs; descriptive median 2.153 A and 5th-95th percentiles 1.931-2.503 A.
